title: User lookup and PDO factory with prepared statements and exceptions
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES or the factory as ceremony. Emulation is disabled so placeholders are real server-side prepares and values can never be reinterpreted as SQL; errmode is set to exceptions so a failed query cannot be mistaken for an empty result; the email is bound through execute() rather than concatenated; and fetch() returning false for 'no row' is normalised to null so callers get one consistent absence signal.
